1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Nd5.strategy: Answers the early bishop at once: the knight jumps to d5 and attacks it. Black has to spend time on the bishop while White's knight stands in the centre.

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Nd5 Nf6.strategy: Develops with a threat: the knight attacks the e4 pawn, which lost its guard when the c3 knight left, and challenges the knight on d5. White can still trade on b4 or f6 first.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Nd5 Nf6.name: Three Knights Opening: Schlechter Variation
